content: This paper presents a novel method for joint feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical responses, using an optimization approach that combines logistic loss and functional principal components. The proposed adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm efficiently handles high-dimensional data, as demonstrated through simulations and a real-world application analyzing chronic diseases and related factors.
